packageRules.description: config:recommended's :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers sets fix:/chore: via packageRules, which override the top-level semanticCommitType; this later rule wins and restores deps: for release-please

The dotnet images must match the API's TargetFramework (net10.0): the 11.0 tag currently carries RC builds and even at GA a net10.0 app cannot start on an 11.0 runtime image. Lift this together with the net11.0 TargetFramework bump.
Require publication timestamps for npm and NuGet cooldown checks
Review release automation library updates monthly with its compatibility tests
schedule: before 4am on the first day of the month
